title: auth/oidc: JWKS cache thunder-herd on force-refresh
description: crates/auth/src/oidc.rs get_keys() — On force-refresh, the write lock is acquired only after fetch_fresh_keys() completes. Two concurrent validate_jwt calls that both see KeyNotFound will both call fetch_fresh_keys() independently, doubling OIDC provider traffic. The cache read also releases the RwLock before calling fetch_fresh_keys, creating a TOCTOU window where expired keys are re-fetched by every concurrent caller. Impact: burst of OIDC HTTP requests during key rotation under load.
